text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Upper block: mean flow in MW by half-hour of the UK clock over the study year (September 2025 to August 2026), weekdays against weekends. Lower block: mean change from one half-hour to the next. Grey dashed lines: the tariff window edges (00:30, 02:00, 05:30, 23:30) and the ends of the red band (16:00 and 19:00). Each panel has its own vertical axis.'
text.tspan: Upper block: mean flow in MW by half-hour of the UK clock over the study year (September 2025 to August 2026),
weekdays against weekends. Lower block: mean change from one half-hour to the next.
Grey dashed lines: the tariff window edges (00:30, 02:00, 05:30, 23:30) and the ends of the red band (16:00 and
19:00). Each panel has its own vertical axis.
